vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Once upon a time, in a big green forest, there lived a little rabbit called Ruby.

vo.speaker: ruby
vo.text: Hello! I'm Ruby! Today is Bobo's big picnic party!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Ruby picked a basket full of crunchy orange carrots for the party.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: How many carrots? Let's count! One, two, three, four, five!

vo.speaker: ruby
vo.text: Five carrots! I want to be the first one at the party! Hop, hop, hop!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: On the path, Ruby saw Milo the mouse. He looked sad.

vo.speaker: milo
vo.text: Ruby... I'm so hungry. Can I have one carrot, please?

vo.speaker: ruby
vo.text: Sorry, Milo! I'm in a hurry!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: And Ruby hopped away. Fast, fast, fast.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: But soon, Ruby's tummy felt funny. Her ears drooped down.

vo.speaker: ruby
vo.text: Oh... I feel bad. Milo was hungry, and I didn't help him.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: That funny feeling is called feeling sorry.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What should Ruby do now? What do you think?

vo.speaker: ruby
vo.text: I'll go back! Hop, hop, hop!

vo.speaker: ruby
vo.text: Milo, I'm sorry I hurried past you. Here, have a carrot!

vo.speaker: milo
vo.text: Thank you, Ruby! Crunch, crunch! Yum!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Ruby felt warm and happy inside. Being kind feels good!

vo.speaker: ruby
vo.text: I feel happy again! Hop, hop, hop!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Then Ruby heard a little peep. Tilly the bird was stuck in a bush!

vo.speaker: tilly
vo.text: Peep, peep! Help! My wing is caught in the leaves!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Will Ruby stop to help? What do you think?

vo.speaker: ruby
vo.text: Don't worry, Tilly! I'll help you. Gently, gently...

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Ruby moved the leaves very gently. And Tilly was free!

vo.speaker: tilly
vo.text: Peep, peep! Thank you, Ruby! You're so kind!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Next, Ruby met Tom the turtle. He was very slow, and the party was far away.

vo.speaker: tom
vo.text: Oh dear... I'm so slow. I will miss the party.

vo.speaker: ruby
vo.text: Hmm... if I help Tom, I will be even later. But Tom needs a friend!

vo.speaker: ruby
vo.text: Climb into my basket, Tom! We'll go together!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: So Ruby hopped along, with Tom in her basket. Hop, hop, hop!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Ruby was the very last one at the party.

vo.speaker: ruby
vo.text: I'm late... and now I only have four carrots.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: But then... surprise!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Ruby! Milo told us how kind you were! We saved you the best seat!

vo.speaker: milo
vo.text: And I brought you some sweet berries!

vo.speaker: tilly
vo.text: And I made you a flower crown! Peep!

vo.speaker: tom
vo.text: Thank you for carrying me, Ruby.

vo.speaker: ruby
vo.text: Thank you, friends! Let's share everything, carrots and berries for everyone!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Kindness always comes back to you.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Say it with me! Kindness always comes back!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What kind things can we do? Let's see!

vo.speaker: ruby
vo.text: We can share our snacks!

vo.speaker: milo
vo.text: We can help a friend clean up!

vo.speaker: tilly
vo.text: We can say nice words! You are my friend!

vo.speaker: tom
vo.text: We can wait, and help a slow friend.

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: And we can give a big, warm hug!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Kindness chant! Help a friend! Share a snack! Kindness always comes right back!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Your turn! Help a friend! Share a snack! Kindness always comes right back!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Let's remember the story!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Who was hungry on the path?

vo.speaker: milo
vo.text: Me! Milo the mouse!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: How did Ruby feel, when she hurried past Milo?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: She felt bad. She felt sorry.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Who did Ruby carry in her basket?

vo.speaker: tom
vo.text: Me! Tom the turtle!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What did Tilly make for Ruby?

vo.speaker: tilly
vo.text: A flower crown! Peep!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: And what does kindness always do?

vo.speaker: ruby
vo.text: It always comes back!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Now it is your turn. When were YOU kind to a friend? Tell a grown-up!

vo.speaker: ruby
vo.text: Bye-bye, friends! Be kind!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: See you next time!
